description: Shared Renovate config for the openweft org. Edit here to propagate to every repo on its next Renovate run. Each repo extends via: github>openweft/.github:renovate-default

packageRules.description: Group go module minor+patch bumps under one PR per week
Major go module bumps : one PR per package, labeled for review

_comment_postUpdateOptions: gomodVendor matters for the seven repos here that build with -mod=vendor (weft, weft-microvm, weft-microvm-agent, weft-network, weft-webui, weft-ha-postgresql, terraform-provider-weft). Without it Renovate edits go.mod and leaves vendor/ untouched, so the branch cannot build at all -- `go build -mod=vendor` fails on the go.mod parse before it compiles anything -- and Renovate's own renovate/artifacts check reports 'Artifact file update failure'. Harmless for the other repos: with no vendor/ directory there is nothing to vendor.
